peer_identity.arc_label: Honorata who survived via time fissure—aged 20 years, manipulative, calculating strategist
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Pushes Shabda-Oud psychic power beyond training limits; can open time fissures. Conceals survival strategically. Uses scent and private phrases as identity proof. Forces binary choice on Aghnar. Nightly appearance limited to ~30 seconds behind isolation requirement. Capable of chrono-temporal manipulation and deep psycho-surgery.
peer_identity.rationale: After the apparent heart-bomb death, Honorata used Shabda-Oud time-acceleration to survive and age from 30 to 50 inside a time fissure. This is a fundamentally different operational phase: she deliberately concealed her survival from Aghnar for years, performed dangerous psycho-surgery on Oda, and forced a binary choice ('between Oda and me'). The VOICE here is 'calm, unapologetically calculating; argues that concealing emotion protected the family from hostile entities.' The vol12 record is the same temporal event (reaching the precise Pradex point) referenced mechanically. This persona cannot share a card with the living trainer because the manipulation and concealment contradict the martyr's sacrifice.

appearances: description: Cloaked female figure; long pale/white hair; calm and composed demeanor; later shown immobilized in medical machinery; source_refs: ['211_The_Metabarons_8_p06', '213_The_Metabarons_8_p08', '216_The_Metabarons_8_p11']
important_actions: action: Opened a time fissure at the Maxiprotonic Tower at age 30 (with ~5 minutes to live), remaining inside for 20 years and emerging at 50 with a new beating heart; source_refs: ['213_The_Metabarons_8_p08']
action: Reached Chrono-G (punctual Pradex point) and spent years studying how to safely remove a heart-bomb with assistants; source_refs: ['214_The_Metabarons_8_p09']
action: Underwent a high-risk heart transplant; received an Arcturian Katria agent's organ; source_refs: ['215_The_Metabarons_8_p10']
action: Hid her survival from Aghnar for years, deliberately preserving his grief and hatred to drive him toward destroying the Shabda-Oud; source_refs: ['216_The_Metabarons_8_p11']
action: Rescued Aghnar in a space battle against tentacled enemies (implied as the mysterious rescuer) and urged psychic union; source_refs: ['210_The_Metabarons_8_p04-p05']
action: Revealed herself to Aghnar using her perfume and a phrase about Okkhar's carnivorous flowers; source_refs: ['212_The_Metabarons_8_p07']
action: Performed dangerous psycho-surgery (deep mental probe) on Oda, nearly exhausting her energy; required years of strict isolation afterward; source_refs: ['218_The_Metabarons_8_p13']
action: Forced Aghnar to choose between her and Oda; accepted his choice of Oda as fulfilling the Castaka bloodline's continuation; source_refs: ['218_The_Metabarons_8_p13']
action: Secluded herself in the south gallery post-procedure; appeared nightly for exactly ~30 seconds before retreating; source_refs: ['221_The_Metabarons_8_p16', '222_The_Metabarons_8_p17']
action: Accused by a robot of using a corpse to fake nightly appearances to Aghnar; source_refs: ['223_The_Metabarons_8_p18']
action: Accused by Aghnar of cloning herself within Oda via a Lota-linked virus and occupying her body; source_refs: ['224_The_Metabarons_8_p19']
action: Unleashed a devastating energy beam tearing through the mechanical interior (likely); source_refs: ['225_The_Metabarons_8_p20']
knowledge_boundaries: Her exact motivation for cloning herself within Oda (if true) is only presented through Aghnar's accusation—not independently confirmed by the pages
Her full awareness of the infant's fate after she is accused and the energy blast occurs is not shown

character: Oda; type: daughter-in-law / surgery subject; notes: Performs psycho-surgery to revive Oda using Shabda-Oud techniques
character: Tonto; type: surgical assistant; notes: Specifically requests Tonto as assistant for Oda's procedure

traits: Extremely powerful psychic—pushed her shabda-ud power beyond training limits
Capable of manipulating chrono-temporal forces (opening time fissures)
Possesses psychic sonar capable of detecting emotional states and foreseeing deaths

Calm and unapologetically calculating in her justifications

Argues that breaking emotion-concealment would have exposed them to hostile entities that detect feelings

Invites Aghnar to board her ship to escape
Forces binary choice: 'between Oda and me'
On Aghnar's choice: 'The Castakas must continue'
Nightly appearance lasts only ~30 seconds; performs a formal wave before retreating

fact: Spent 20 subjective years inside a time fissure, emerging biologically aged from 30 to 50; source_refs: ['213_The_Metabarons_8_p08']
fact: Reached the fortress tower in 16.09 seconds after the Metabunker departed with Aghnar and his father; source_refs: ['213_The_Metabarons_8_p08']
